name: How can I identify rot damage around my windows?

mainEntity.name: How can I identify rot damage around my windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for visual cues like discolored, soft, or crumbly wood. You might also see cracks in the paint, peeling paint, or a musty odor near the windows. Probing the wood with a screwdriver can reveal soft spots. Small holes may indicate insect activity attracted by the damp wood. Early detection is key to preventing more extensive and costly repairs.
